facts.cue: Lots of musicians were waiting on the stage.
facts.text: A band of musicians dressed in black sat on stage behind music stands.

facts.cue: Someone stepped forward to face the crowd.
facts.text: A man in a dark suit stood at the front left of the stage, facing the audience.

moment.place: A concert hall with a stage, seen from the audience seats
moment.summary: A short clip filmed from the audience of a concert hall. A band dressed in black sits on stage with music stands and instruments, while a man in a dark suit stands near the front of the stage facing the audience and then walks off to the left.
